_comment: PathTriage Primitive 01 — IMDS extraction preventive SCP. Enforces IMDSv2 organisation-wide by denying IMDSv1 access. Companion to the detection query in cloudtrail_lake_query.sql.

_notes.coverage: Prevents IMDSv1 use at instance-launch and instance-modification time. Existing instances with IMDSv1 enabled remain vulnerable until re-launched or explicitly reconfigured; the ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions deny covers the reconfiguration path.
_notes.hop_limit_rationale: Hop limit ≤ 2 prevents containerised SSRF from reaching IMDS across container-to-host network boundary. Combined with IMDSv2's token exchange, this closes the SSRF-to-credential path (P2) at the network layer.
_notes.residual_risk: SCP does not prevent P1 (PassRole+RunInstances) or P6 (Instance Profile Abuse) — both attacks assume the attacker can reach IMDS legitimately (P1 as the instance launcher, P6 as an on-instance attacker). Detection primitive is required for these paths.
_notes.deployment: Attach at the organisation root or applicable OUs. Test in a non-production OU first — existing workloads relying on IMDSv1 will fail after deployment.
